videos.title: Abadas
videos.description: The `Abadas' try to find the exciting new word, which is `buoy'.

videos.title: Peicein
videos.description: Petit invites his friends to his dad's workplace, but his dad won't let them touch anything except the floor, and they start to get really bored. Finally, Petit's dad shows them how carpentry can be lots of fun.

videos.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag
videos.description: Pompon catches his mother preparing a surprise show for Georges' birthday. She asks him to keep it secret, but the little bear finds it challenging to hold his tongue.

videos.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh
videos.description: It is a peaceful day but Neep is digging holes all over the island and won't stop. Abney and Teal try to work out why he is so excited. It must be his birthday.

videos.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach
videos.description: With the moon growing thinner and the woods growing darker night by night, Owl begins to feel lonely and starts to dread his duties. Luckily, Hare has a plan!

videos.title: An Là
videos.description: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Presenting local, national, and international news and information.

videos.title: Live: Scottish League One
videos.description: Ball-coise beò bho Lìog a h-aon le Montrose a' cur fàilte air Alloa Athletic. An geama slàn ri fhaicinn le aithris bho Ailig O' Henley.

videos.title: Bus Ghlaschú
videos.description: The story of the Glasgow bus, a lifeline between Donegal and the Scottish city.

videos.title: Dàna: Scotland's Wild Side
videos.description: A' sireadh Dànachd anns an Roinn Eòrpa, tha Coinneach MacFhraing a' siubhal gu dùthaich nam beann iongantach, Nirribhidh. Seeking grand adventure, Coinneach Rankin travels to Norway to make an ascent of the country's national mountain, Stetind.

videos.title: Rathad Ramsay
videos.description: Ramsay MacMahon walks through Lochalsh with Coinneach Rankin. Tha Ramsay MacMahon air chuairt tro Loch Aillse còmhla ri Coinneach MacFhraing.

videos.title: Seirm
videos.description: Màiri Anna NicUalraig a' lìbhrigeadh prògraim-ciùil bho Celtic Connections 2024. Mary Ann Kennedy presents performances from Carlene Carter, Ewen Henderson, Talisk and intimate session recordings with Sarah Jarosz and Muireann Bradley.

videos.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal
videos.description: The triplets reunite, Emily is tested, Diane struggles, and Tom Óg progresses.

videos.title: Fraochy Bay
videos.description: A few cases are due to be heard. Just what kind of mayhem and miscreants have been stalking the streets of Fraochy Bay?

videos.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
videos.description: Skipinnish le Alba and Nelson Mandela ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a' comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform Alba and Nelson Mandela from Edinburgh Castle.

videos.title: Third Lanark
videos.description: In 1967, as it edged towards its centenary, a much-loved social and cultural institution was consigned to history. Following 95 years of emotional highs and lows, Glasgow's Third Lanark Athletic Club was bankrupt, and the gates to Cathkin Park were closed.

videos.title: Belladrum
videos.description: Highlights from Belladrum 2022, including The Magic Numbers and Passenger.

videos.description: Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a' gabhail pàirt ann an latha chleasan nan Losgann. Ziff, Pipp and Button compete in their own Froggie sports day.

videos.title: Na Clangers
videos.description: Tha am Màidsear air innleachd eile a chruthachadh - inneal glanaidh. Major has come up with one of his useful inventions, but no one is allowed to touch it while he is away. However, Beag doesn't listen to him.

videos.title: Na Clangers
videos.description: Tha Beag den bheachd gum b' chòir là sònraichte bhith ann airson Dràgon Brot. The Clangers would like to organise a special day for Soup Dragon as she is so kind and generous to everyone.

videos.title: Creag nam Buthaidean
videos.description: There's a bee trapped in Bernie's grotto but, without anything to eat, he has become too weak to escape and make his way back to the hive! However, Oona and Baba are on hand to find and bring him the food he needs to build his strength back up!

videos.title: Creag nam Buthaidean
videos.description: Mossy wants the gang to join him on a food hunt, but they are all called on a different sort of search when Pip and Pop decide to hide on poor Otto!

videos.title: Bing
videos.description: Tha Bing is a cairdean a' tarraing dhealbhan-duilleig an-diugh. Bing and his friends are making leaf pictures today.

videos.title: Bing
videos.description: Tha einnsean-smàlaidh sa phàirc agus tha a h-uile duine airson suidhe na bhroinn. There is a fire engine in the park and everybody wants to get a chance to sit inside it.

videos.title: Peicein
videos.description: Petit and Laura argue about who should be the one that makes the rules of Greg and Roman's game.

videos.title: Hilda
videos.description: Tha Hilda, Flòraidh is Daibhidh a' feuchainn ri bràistean Sgùdan Sporais às ùr a chosnadh. Tha 'ad dol a' shireadh planntraisean annasach ionadail. Hilda, Flòraidh and Daibhidh try to earn new Sgùdan Sporrais badges. They search for rare plants.

videos.title: Geamaichean Gorach
videos.description: Nothing will stop Coinneach Clogaid, except for a tree.

videos.title: Geamaichean Gorach
videos.description: As ever, Coinneach Clogaid is trying to stop all the other competitors. Don't tell me he's going to win this time though.

videos.title: Geamaichean Gorach
videos.description: There are many tasteful things to behold, except for Coinneach Clogaid, of course.

videos.title: Flix
videos.description: As part of a school presentation, Flix and Burma are challenged to overcome their differences, and see if they can be friends. Flix is well up for it.

videos.title: A-null 's a-nall
videos.description: Ged nach eil e àbhaisteach 'son nighean Ròma, tha Lena airson a bhith na ballerina. Although not usual for a Roma girl, Lena wishes to be a ballerina.

videos.title: An Là
videos.description: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Presenting local, national, and international news and information.

videos.title: Seachd Là
videos.description: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

videos.title: Alleluia
videos.description: Psalm 68 sung by Norrie MacIver, the hymn Mìorbhail Ghràis by Mairi MacInnes and Donna Barden tells her personal faith story. Presented by Iain MacKinnon.

videos.title: Port An Obain
videos.description: We meet Oban resident Duncan MacNeil, who works as a Gaelic officer, and also Sileas Sinclair, who keeps alive the family passion for traditional music.

videos.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
videos.description: Interior designer Erica Macpherson transforms rooms, homes and businesses. Follows her process from architectural plans to trawling auction houses and shops for the finishing touches.

videos.title: Surfing: Marcachd an Tuinn
videos.description: Tha Ceitlin Lilidh a' toirt thugainn sreath de dhà phàirt air eachdraidh surfadh air feadh an t-saoghail. Ceitlin Lilidh presents a look at the world history and culture of surfing.

videos.title: Seirm

videos.title: Ciad-fathan nan Creutairean
videos.description: Cànan dìomhair fàilidhean agus blas. The secret language of scents and flavour.

videos.title: Aig an Taigh le Abigail
videos.description: Tha trèat sònraicht' aig Abigail 'son lòn, Bagelean a tha soirbh an dèanamh. Abigail shows how to bake easy homemade bagels for a special and delicious lunch treat.

videos.title: Daolag-bhreac is Seillean
videos.description: Tha Daolag-bhreac air bhioran - an e àite draoidheil a tha seo? E fèir mìorbhaileach! Daolag-bhreac is excited, is this a magic place? It's just amazing.

videos.title: Creag nam Buthaidean
videos.description: Mossy is excited to bring his new friend, Fred, to today's play date, but the rest of the gang are less than enamoured when they learn that Fred is actually a flea. However, Fred soon shows that he is quite useful to have around!

videos.title: Creag nam Buthaidean
videos.description: Bernie has a girlfriend, and she's on her way to the grotto for dinner! However, Bernie has no idea what to prepare for her. Oona and Baba agree to help him out but, with Mossy joining the fray, will there be any food left for the special guest?

videos.title: Boban is Fuigheag
videos.description: Tha Fuigheag a' faighinn trèat 'son a cho-là-breith an-diugh ach, gu mì-fhortanach, chan eil cùisean ag obrachadh a-mach, mar bu chòir!

videos.title: Losgannan
videos.description: Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a' dol a chladhach airson ionmhais àrsaidh san t-sloc-gainmhich. Ziff, Pipp and Button set out to unearth ancient treasures buried in the garden sandpit.

videos.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach
videos.description: Brush invites Hare, Fox, Owl and Tusk for a fancy game of croquet. Jack shows up uninvited and wants to play, too. But being a villain, he can't stand rules and ruins the game for everyone. Just at the moment the friends are about to give up, Hare reverses the rules to make Jack think he's cheating but in fact he's playing the game perfectly.

videos.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag
videos.description: Pompon becomes upset after missing the sunrise with Rita due to brushing his teeth. He resolves to eat only 'clean' food henceforth, hoping to avoid dirtying his teeth and future tooth-brushing delays.

videos.title: Stòiridh
videos.description: Angela Mackay reads 'Rionnag ann an Sileagan' written and illustrated by Sam Hay and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: Mr. Krabs has a holiday and makes Larry the Lobster the temporary manager of the Krusty Krab.

videos.title: An Sgoil
videos.description: Tha Mrs NicArtair air tàlant ùr a lorg sa chlas ealain aice. Mrs MacArthur has unearthed a new talent in her art class, but Mr Hobson is not sure if it is talent or perhaps a more troubling issue that's behind the artwork.

videos.title: Flix
videos.description: Flix is eager to hang out and help out Munchkin at the Tiger Milk Café, when Munchkin's parents leave him in charge for a few hours. However, Flix's enthusiastic efforts to help backfire.

videos.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan
videos.description: After being captured by the snikes and put in the mattress mine, Tink, Bounce and Willi bicker about whose escape plan is the best. Above them, the Bottersnikes hold a pageant to crown the ugliest snike on Snike Hill.

videos.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan
videos.description: Bounce is taken captive by a colony of grubs, and soon finds that she enjoys their company. After her safe return she begins behaving like one, landing herself and her friends in trouble on Snike Hill.

videos.title: Fillte
videos.description: The history behind the artisan producers of woven fabrics, such as wool, hemp, linen, grasses, leather, and many more unorthodox fabrics.

videos.title: SpeakGaelic
videos.description: Meet learner Sophie Day from Falkirk. Plus, Calum Maclean keeps a keen eye on the tide whilst on the hunt for spectacular cave art on Davaar Island in the Mull of Kintyre.

videos.title: An Là
videos.description: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Presenting local, national, and international news and information.

videos.title: Mas Fhior
videos.description: Can Kerry and Katie, with Benjamin and Calum in the studio, beat the Pretenders?

videos.title: Trusadh
videos.description: Na tha e ciallachadh a bhith dol tro làn-sgur fuil-mìosa san là an-diugh. Cathy Macdonald meets women at different stages of their journey to find out just what it means to go through the menopause.

videos.title: An Clò Mòr
videos.description: The community gathers for a fundraiser ceilidh for Old Mary, who is recovering from her mill accident. A drunken Boyd confronts Mairead and Cairistiona in front of everyone at the ceilidh. Things turn sour between Johan and Murdina, resulting in a mysterious fire starting at the hotel, trapping Murdina and Boyd inside.

videos.title: An Balla
videos.description: Síle Nic Chonaonaigh discovers more about life along the border between Finland and Russia. Since Russia's attack on Ukraine the border has been closed, transforming the lives of people on both sides.

videos.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
videos.description: Skipinnish le Alba and Nelson Mandela ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a' comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform Alba and Nelson Mandela from Edinburgh Castle.

videos.title: Glan Fhein
videos.description: Angela and Katie compete against Shonnie and Calum from rival company Sgiobalta. The timing isn't perfect, as it clashes with the anniversary of Katie's disastrous reality TV appearance.
